claims.location: characteristics[genotype] rows 1-80 and factor value[genotype] rows 1-80
claims.evidence: Paper: "analyzing 3 Fabry clones versus 3 WT clones"; CRISPR/Cas9 GLA knockout of immortalized human podocytes. Per-row value from the channel map. Column naming follows campaign precedent PXD010683.

Each of the 4 mixtures contains an independently SILAC-labelled KO culture and WT culture (label swap); numbered 1 (867_sample1), 2 (867_sample2), 3 (899_sample1), 4 (899_sample2) within each genotype group (batch rule 3).

Paper calls the GLA-KO podocytes "Fabry clones"/"Fabry podocytes" (in vitro Fabry model); WT clones are unmodified CIHP-1 podocytes (Cellosaurus lists no disease). MONDO:0010526, PATO:0000461. Project-level disease not broadcast onto WT rows.
PRIDE organisms NEWT:9606; Cellosaurus OX NCBI_TaxID=9606.
Cellosaurus CVCL_W186: Derived from site: Kidney; UBERON_0002113.
Cellosaurus Cell type: Podocyte; CL_0000653. PRIDE organismPart "podocyte (sensu Diptera)" CL:0000391 is a submitter error and was not used.
Conditionally immortalized human podocyte line.

limitations: PARTIAL SCOPE: 20 of 60 raw files are not annotated: 20160120_VD_CFP910_sample_1_1..10.RAW and 20160112_VD_CFP_911_2_01..10.raw. They are not in the deposited MaxQuant search (txt.zip summary.txt lists only the 40 CFP867/CFP899 runs), so their channel use (light or medium) and orientation cannot be documented; Fig. 2A does not tie mixes to file names. See annotations/BLOCKED.md section PXD029618.

Channel->genotype map rests on the deposited ratios reproducing the paper Figure 2B per-replicate heatmap (16-19/20 cells per experiment), not on an explicit per-file label statement. Fig. 2A schematic conflicts with the data on label identity (#899 mixes are light+heavy, not medium+heavy) and on which label carries KO in column/mix 1; the deposited data were followed.
Which clone pair (KO-1/WT-1, KO-2/WT-2, KO-3/WT-3) each mixture contains is not documented per file; clone identity is not asserted.
Precursor mass tolerance not recorded by MaxQuant 1.4.1.2 output; convert-openms therefore fails (expected).
Fractionation method of the 10 runs per mixture is undocumented (not available).
SILAC labelling medium is not named; RPMI 1640 is the paper's stated podocyte culture medium.
Sex: paper says male, Cellosaurus says unspecified.
proteinGroups.txt contains a MaxQuant buffer-corruption artefact in one row (non-UTF-8 bytes); parsed with latin-1 and non-numeric values skipped.
